### (a) Social posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. Not just a fortunate few. Everyone.

2. We stand for a future where extraordinary wealth belongs to everyone. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than today’s richest 1%.

3. We reject the idea that immense wealth must remain the privilege of a few. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are now.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are now. We mean everyone—not only investors, technology leaders, or people born into opportunity. We see this as a transformation in what humanity can produce, create, and enjoy: abundance that reaches beyond today’s fortunes and across every border. We reject the assumption that prosperity on this scale must belong to a privileged minority. Our ambition is universal wealth, and we are putting that ambition at the centre of our work. We invite you to join us in championing that future.
